related_questions.question: What is life expectancy after a stroke?
related_questions.snippet: About half of people survive for at least 5 years after an ischemic stroke. A large 2019 Swedish study including people who survived at least 30 days after a first stroke found a 5-year survival rate of 49.4% for those who had an ischemic stroke.

related_questions.question: What does the stroke foundation do?
related_questions.snippet: The Stroke Foundation stands alongside survivors of stroke and their families, healthcare professionals and researchers. They build community awareness and foster new thinking. They support survivors on their journey to live the best possible life after stroke.

related_questions.question: What is the hardest stroke to recover from?
related_questions.snippet: Recovery is most difficult with hemorrhagic strokes. They progress more quickly than ischemic strokes and may cause more damage before you receive treatment. Also, they can be harder to treat effectively.
